prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Create an original illustrated nursing memory poster, portrait 2:3, clear large lettering, detailed friendly hand-painted medical cartoon scenes. Dark navy, emerald, sapphire, amethyst jewel tones with a subtle abstract Klimt-inspired gold mosaic border; bright cream text; no busy decoration behind text. Title "ISOLATION MEMORY DOORS". Subtitle "Standard precautions for every patient". Three distinct horizontal panels stacked vertically with generous spacing. Top emerald CONTACT panel: a friendly original character named Mrs. Wee wears a gown and gloves and holds up a no-touch palm at a door; several small harmless stylized germs on nearby objects. Exact labels: "CONTACT", "MRS. WEE: don't touch me", "Gown + gloves". Middle sapphire DROPLET panel: an original charming spider nurse wearing a surgical mask, suspended from a thread, with a few large droplets falling downward. This is a generic spider, not a superhero. Exact labels: "DROPLET", "The spider drops down", "Surgical mask". Bottom amethyst AIRBORNE panel: a retro television with three glowing screens, a measles rash symbol, lungs for TB, and chickenpox spots; beside it a nurse in a properly fitted N95 respirator. Arrow at the door points INTO the room to symbolize negative pressure. Exact labels: "AIRBORNE", "MTV: Measles • TB • Varicella", "N95 + negative-pressure room". Bottom gold high-visibility note: "Varicella also needs CONTACT precautions". Small footer: "Memory cues, not a complete isolation policy • Original Study Hub artwork". Do not show illness lists beyond these exact labels. Each picture must clearly support its label. Natural human anatomy, no copied commercial mascots or logos. Whole poster uncropped.
